parameters.query:
=WITH ticket_check AS (
  SELECT t.id AS ticket_id, t.ticket_number, t.status, t.customer_id, t.conversation_id
  FROM tickets t
  WHERE t.ticket_number = '{{ $json.ticket_number }}'
  LIMIT 1
),
survey_check AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS survey_count
  FROM csat_surveys
  WHERE ticket_number = '{{ $json.ticket_number }}'
)
SELECT tc.*, COALESCE(sc.survey_count, 0) AS existing_surveys
FROM ticket_check tc
CROSS JOIN survey_check sc;

parameters.query:
=WITH inserted_survey AS (
  INSERT INTO csat_surveys (ticket_number, conversation_id, customer_id, rating, feedback, channel)
  VALUES (
    '{{ $('Validate CSAT Input').first().json.ticket_number }}',
    '{{ $json.conversation_id || "a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001" }}'::uuid,
    '{{ $json.customer_id || "a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001" }}'::uuid,
    {{ $('Validate CSAT Input').first().json.rating }},
    '{{ $('Validate CSAT Input').first().json.feedback }}',
    'webchat'
  )
  RETURNING id, rating, created_at, customer_id, ticket_number
),
updated_ticket AS (
  UPDATE tickets
  SET csat_score = {{ $('Validate CSAT Input').first().json.rating }},
      updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
  WHERE ticket_number = '{{ $('Validate CSAT Input').first().json.ticket_number }}'
  RETURNING ticket_number
),
updated_customer AS (
  UPDATE customers
  SET csat_avg = (
        SELECT ROUND(AVG(s.rating)::numeric, 2)
        FROM csat_surveys s
        WHERE s.customer_id = (SELECT customer_id FROM inserted_survey)
      ),
      total_tickets = (
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM tickets t
        WHERE t.customer_id = (SELECT customer_id FROM inserted_survey)
      ),
      last_activity_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
  WHERE id = (SELECT customer_id FROM inserted_survey)
  RETURNING id, csat_avg, total_tickets
)
SELECT isrv.id AS survey_id,
       isrv.rating,
       isrv.ticket_number,
       uc.csat_avg AS customer_csat_avg,
       uc.total_tickets
FROM inserted_survey isrv
LEFT JOIN updated_customer uc ON uc.id = isrv.customer_id;

=INSERT INTO audit_logs (workflow_name, event_type, channel, payload)
VALUES (
  '08_csat_survey',

  json_build_object(
    'survey_id', '{{ $json.survey_id }}',
    'ticket_number', '{{ $json.ticket_number }}',
    'rating', {{ $json.rating }},
    'customer_csat_avg', '{{ $json.customer_csat_avg }}'
  )
);
